snippet.title: ⠀　⠀⠀　⠀　　⠀ ⠀⠀⠀⠀　⠀ ⠀　⠀⠀: the prologue - arcINDIE 2025 trailer
snippet.description:
⠀　⠀⠀　⠀　　⠀ ⠀⠀⠀⠀　⠀ ⠀　⠀⠀  is a surreal RPG-ish Yume Nikki clone where words are a scarce resource.
Exploration is bizarre, unclear, battles are annoying, and every little letter you find may be the key to not lose progress in the weird and badly designed world of the indie game named ⠀　⠀⠀　⠀　　⠀ ⠀⠀⠀⠀　⠀ ⠀　⠀⠀ .

new demo containing the full prologue november 15th, so make a reminder for it:
https://phiiraco.itch.io/collision-system-test

Follow me on bluesky for more updates:
https://bsky.app/profile/philraco.lhlgames.com
or join the discussion discord server:
https://discord.com/invite/2beZeZkuWr

Note that ⠀　⠀⠀　⠀　　⠀ ⠀⠀⠀⠀　⠀ ⠀　⠀⠀ is in active development, and while I will soon upload a devlog where I talk about how I got here and about adding more depth and a very unique dialogue and traversal system... you shouldn't buy a promise though, which is why I'm okay if you don't give two flicks about my silly anti-design game. You be you!
